references.text: The same warning that a foreigner who approaches the tabernacle shall die, emphasizing that only the Levites were to serve at the tabernacle.
Repeats the principle that foreigners who approach the sanctuary shall die, and that Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to guard the tabernacle.
Aaron and his sons are charged with maintaining the priesthood, and foreigners who approach shall die.
Aaron and his sons are chosen for priestly service among the children of Israel.
The priesthood is given to Aaron and his sons as a permanent ordinance.
Reminder that no foreigner, not of Aaron's lineage, may approach to burn incense before the Lord.
Aaron's sons must keep away from the holy offerings of the Israelites so as not to profane the name of the Lord.
No one takes upon themselves the honor of becoming high priest; they must be called by God, just as Aaron was.
